newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: No buyers for Venezuela's Latino de Seguros. [CORRECTED 18:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: No buyers for Venezuela's Latino de Seguros. [CORRECTED 18:30 GMT]

text.p: The auction of Venezuelan insurance company Latino de Seguros was called off Monday after no bids were presented, said Antonio Golding, vice president of privatization at state-owned Grupo Latino. (Corrects Golding's position)
Golding said four companies had shown an interest in the small insurance company, valued at 1.7 billion bolivars ($3.6 million), but none had decided to bid.
Banco Latino with its related companies was the first Venezuelan bank to be taken over by the state in the 1994-95 financial crisis which swallowed half of the commercial banking sector.
Golding said a new auction of Latino de Seguros would be called after about 45 days.
